correctness.rationale: Classical odd-theta/Steiner geometry gives the 35-by-28 within-block incidence matrix; every selected complex has 12 bitangents. Counting identical/shared/disjoint pair intersections proves \(M^{\mathsf T}M=8I-2A+7J\); elementary triangular-graph spectra give eigenvalues 180, 0^7, 12^20, hence rational rank21 and equal-vertex-degree saturation. A 474-operation integer unimodular certificate replays to exact diagonal \(1^{\times7},2^{\times13},6,0^{\times7}\); a separate SymPy Smith calculation agreed. Standalone checks include Gram, seven kernel witnesses, equivariance and modular ranks 7,20,21.

value.rationale: An even theta marking canonically distinguishes exactly 35 of the 63 Steiner complexes. Their precise integral span is the natural question of reconstructing formal bitangent sums using only those marked complexes. The result gives an intrinsic equal-degree saturation, an exact 49152 index, seven rational obstructions and a nontrivial order-three integral obstruction. Neither the classical pair/partition description nor the complete 63-complex Smith form determines those facts; the invariant can inform integral incidence and arithmetic permutation-module presentations without claiming downstream geometry.
